title: Norfolk Submarine Pier 3 Utility Services
scope: Complete supplied 27-page mechanical delivery, not the absent 573 sheets of the 600-sheet project. All unique scheduled and additional printed equipment identities, all schedule cells/notes, every printed BAS row and explicit typical application, every sheet/view scale, and the complete primary-plan space-control-symbol inventory are retained. Generic untagged commodity quantities, exact field terminal assignments, and values not established by the PDF remain explicitly unknown rather than invented.
reading_notes: Schedule rows, equipment identities, outlet types, installed devices and logical BAS applications are different quantities.

24 equipment schedules contain 105 rows and 109 building-scoped tag identities, including 10 repeated outlet types. The other 99 scheduled identities each have a primary plan anchor. An additional 19 printed identities include plan-only equipment, controls-referenced equipment and the EG-3 outlet type.

15 actuated-water-valve rows and 21 motorized-damper rows are included. No standalone actuator schedule is present. This is not a claim that only 36 actuator motors exist; torque/model and hardware multiplicity are not supplied.

117 printed/template BAS rows normalize to 31 AI / 43 DI / 10 AO / 33 DO. 26 explicit applications contain 192 logical occurrences: 48 AI / 72 DI / 13 AO / 59 DO. These are not physical field terminals; shared/unmarked sensors and grouped dampers prevent a defensible exact installed I/O count.

23 drawn space-control marks: 21 T and 2 S. One further gatehouse DSS-3 DDC sensor is required but not separately located. CO2 sensors are absent from the supplied PDF; internet-connected smart-thermostat capability is not stated.
Table rows retain literal units, comparison operators, empty cells, alarm/trend flags and source errors. A source conflict is not silently corrected by a plausible engineering assumption.

All source bounds are displayed-page PDF points, top-left origin. Text-region bounds locate evidence, not equipment outlines. Parser agreement corroborates text and location; visual review establishes drawn relationships.

The component files are corroborated parts of this document. This assembled record's requirement audit and current verification determine document status; no individual component substitutes for the complete audit.

requirement_audit.finding: Printed project/location and classified building functions captured. Firm logo and professional seal independently rendered; full legal firm names and obscured seal-year digit are not invented.
All 27 sheet numbers/titles, project ordinals and per-sheet approval dates recorded. Revision grids are blank; approval, plot, form revision and issue dates remain separate.
59 numbered views; 22 length-scaled views, 21 graphic bars. Exterior pipe stand is scaled but has no graphic bar. AS NOTED is not a global distance ratio.

109 scoped scheduled identities reconciled to rows; 99 non-outlet primary anchors, 10 outlet types and 19 additional identities. Roof/section/diagram redraws do not add units. MPAP-2/CS-4 classes remain unresolved. SG-2 quantity and other conflicting plan data remain unresolved.

All 105 equipment rows/1222 cells retained including guard booth, valve/damper/electrical/performance data, 17 printed note blocks and missing note references. Three reference tables and nine operating-flow combinations are separately classified. Blank/not-stated values and implausible source units are retained.

Every printed point row, type, alarm and trend flag captured, with complete explicit application scope and leaf ownership. Aliases link valve commands to the same points, not additional points. Matrix/diagram MPAC naming conflicts remain visible. Unnumbered functions and shared inputs prevent physical-terminal inference.

USB BACnet IP, BACnet MS/TP, router, fiber reference, operator notebook and generic links captured. Controller number/arrangement expressly diagrammatic; four panel locations do not prove four controllers. Per-point transport and wiring quantities not stated.

All nine written sequence groups and their diagrams located, with setpoints, alarms, interlocks, timing, resets and material contradictions retained. Complete condenser-water diagram and state/valve-name witnesses reviewed. No undocumented safety point or standby sequence invented.

Complete enlarged-floor-plan inventory: 23 distinct drawn T/S marks by zone and served equipment, repeated typical/overall drawings excluded. One required-undrawn DSS-3 DDC sensor, ambiguous EF-6 wall side, four shared MPAC references, unknown humidity hardware and smart capability explicitly retained. CO2 absence checked over all 27 pages.

Conflicts are distributed alongside the affected rows, equipment, sensors, sequences and metadata. No procurement-perfect total is claimed. Absent referenced sheets/specifications and untagged generic commodity counts remain explicit limitations, not silently zeroed quantities.

Each supplied page visually reviewed, including legends, notes, every plan/section/detail, schedules, controls and title blocks. Full-page render inventory retained and hashed; zoomed evidence supplements complete pages.

Two separately captured PDF engines check 1752 authored cells and 710 bounded text assertions (4924 engine checks), plus header witnesses, negative-text search and authored count/reference checks. Logo/seal and geometric connections use disclosed visual review; two parser outputs are not called two independent engineering interpretations.

verification_semantics: MuPDF 1.27.2.2 and Poppler 26.03.0 independently captured all 27 pages. Current modules contain 1752 cell assertions and 710 bounded text assertions; each is checked in both engines, with additional header witnesses and consistency/absence checks. Independent text agreement is not automatic semantic interpretation or symbol counting. Firm/seal outline lettering is visually corroborated using separate engine renderings. The coordinator separately reviewed all source pages and relationships. Generic untagged commodity quantities and missing/conflicting source facts are not fabricated.
